title: Arizona State University Campus Immersion (ASU)
summary: Arizona State University Campus Immersion (ASU) is a university in Tempe. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with ASU.

sections.heading: What ASU is known for
paragraphs: Arizona State University (ASU) is a public institution known for its large and diverse undergraduate enrollment, which totals 64,674 students. The university has an admission rate of 89.89%, reflecting its inclusive admissions approach. ASU is particularly recognized for its strong business programs, which comprise 25.68% of its academic offerings. Additionally, health-related programs represent 5.15% of the university's curriculum, highlighting its commitment to education in the health sciences. These characteristics contribute to ASU's reputation as a comprehensive public university with a broad range of academic disciplines.

sections.heading: Popular majors

sections.heading: How to read ASU tuition
paragraphs: Arizona State University (ASU) tuition varies depending on residency status. For in-state students, the tuition is $12,223, while out-of-state students pay $33,139. The total cost of attendance, which includes tuition, fees, and other expenses, amounts to $30,111. Understanding these figures helps prospective students and families plan for the financial commitment associated with attending ASU.

sections.heading: Financial aid
paragraphs: Arizona State University (ASU) offers financial aid to support students in managing the cost of attendance. Approximately 28.99% of ASU students receive Pell Grants, which are federal subsidies for low-income students. Among those who complete their programs, the median student debt is $19,500. Prospective students can explore detailed financial aid information and use the net price calculator on ASU's official website at www.asu.edu/. Additional data about costs and aid is also available through the College Scorecard at https://collegescorecard.ed.gov/school/?104151.

paragraphs: Arizona State University (ASU) provides housing options for students both on and off campus, with associated room and board costs varying accordingly. For students choosing to live off campus, the average room and board expense is slightly lower, at $14,839 per year. These figures help students and families consider the financial aspects of housing while planning for their time at ASU.

paragraphs: Arizona State University (ASU) is located in Tempe, Arizona, within the zip code 85287. Tempe is a city in the state of Arizona known for its vibrant community and proximity to various cultural and recreational amenities. The ASU campus in Tempe serves as the main campus of the university, offering a diverse range of academic programs and facilities. The location provides students with access to urban resources while maintaining a campus environment conducive to learning and research.

sections.heading: Career outcomes
paragraphs: Arizona State University (ASU) reports a completion rate of approximately 68.04% within 150% of the expected time to graduate. Graduates of ASU have a median earnings of $52,843 six years after entry, which increases to $62,668 ten years after entry, indicating positive career growth over time. Among those who complete their programs, the median student debt is $19,500. These figures provide insight into the financial and career outcomes experienced by ASU students following their education.

sections.heading: Diversity
paragraphs: Arizona State University (ASU) demonstrates a diverse student body with a nearly balanced gender distribution, comprising approximately 51.41% men and 48.59% women. This diversity reflects ASU's commitment to fostering an inclusive academic environment. Additionally, nearly 29% of ASU students receive Pell Grants, indicating a significant portion of the student population benefits from federal financial aid aimed at supporting low-income individuals.
